name: Zero Gravity Shuffle
hook: Feet glide, body floats — then gravity remembers you.
description: Heel-toe slides that never seem to push off the floor, floating transitions and suspended-weight poses, capped by an exaggerated crash back into gravity. Smooth, hypnotic, a little impossible.

movement.firstSecond: Both feet slide half a metre sideways with no visible step while the shoulders rise, as if weight has just switched off.
movement.signature: The Suspend: standing on one leg, other knee raised, whole body leaning ~15° off-axis and held as if floating in orbit.

sequence.name: Lift-off
sequence.description: Sideways heel-toe slide, shoulders rise, arms drift up with palms down.

sequence.name: Drift
sequence.description: Continuous heel-toe glides left and right; arms float at shoulder height.

sequence.name: Gravity returns
sequence.description: Exaggerated drop: knees bend deep, arms slam down, springy recovery bounce.

sequence.name: Back-glide
sequence.description: Backward heel-toe glide, torso upright and calm.

sequence.name: Re-float
sequence.description: Shoulders rise again, settling into the Lift-off stance.

movement.loopPoint: Re-float ends in the exact Lift-off stance, feet together, so the slide restarts seamlessly.
movement.cameraGuidance: Locked-off camera at hip height, slightly wider framing than usual so lateral glides stay in frame. Smooth floor, contrasting shoes.
transferConsiderations: Feet are the identity of this move: shoes must contrast with the floor and never leave frame.
Keep glides under ~0.6s each; very fast foot work tends to smear in motion transfer.
The gravity drop should stay upright — no floor contact with hands or knees.

recipe.prompt: The person from the photo performs smooth gliding footwork that looks weightless, in a clean, evenly lit space. Preserve their face, body shape, hair and clothing exactly. Stable camera, feet always visible.

provenance.notes: Original concept created for TREND MACHINE launch. Uses generic heel-toe footwork vocabulary, not any specific existing routine.

rights.notes: No music is bundled. Audio is handled separately from movement.
